name: Oregon

rule.textEn: Anyone 16 or older needs a boater education card to run a powerboat (PWC included) over 10 hp; youths 12-15 need it to run any motorboat alone.
rule.textEs: Toda persona de 16 años o más necesita la tarjeta de educación náutica para manejar una lancha (incluidas motos acuáticas) de más de 10 hp; de 12 a 15 años la necesitan para manejar sola cualquier lancha con motor.

minAge.note: 12-15: up to 10 hp alone; over 10 hp only with a card holder 16+ (18+ for PWC) on board.

exemptions: Current US Coast Guard boat operator license.
Commercial fishing license holders boating recreationally.
Uncertified adult under direct supervision of a card holder 16+ (18+ for PWC).
Renters, after a watercraft rental safety checklist.

card.feeNote: $20 when applying to the Marine Board by mail or online store; course providers may order it for an added fee.

rental: Renters are exempt but must complete a rental safety checklist.

sources.quote: A person 16 or older will need a boating education card to operate a powerboat (including a PWC) greater than 10 hp.
download an application ​ to print and mail in with a check or money order for $20.
The fee for a replacement boater education card is $16.
Boat renters are exempt from completing a boater education course prior to renting, but must complete a watercraft rental safety checklist prior to departure.
